raw_segments.text: Who was not his friend who had heard him speak once, she was saying.
He drew men towards him by what was best in them.
She looked at me with intensity.
It is the gift of the great, she went on, and the sound of her low voice seemed to have
the accompaniment of all the other sounds.
Full of mystery, desolation, and sorrow, I had ever heard.
The ripple of the river, the sowing of the trees swayed by the wind, the murmurs of the
crowds, the faint ring of incomprehensible words cried from afar, the whisper of a voice
speaking from beyond the threshold of an eternal darkness.
But you have heard him, you know, she cried.
